ruler_notes: no coupling class was declared, so the mechanism-agnostic 'median' Δ-sd row is used. V247_RULER.md §7: 'Any pre-reg must declare its expected coupling class (exit-only / sizing-only / selection-changing) — it determines which MDE row applies.' The ruler will not infer one from results. This is the CONSERVATIVE direction for a no-regression gate: the median Δ-sd is the widest of the low-coupling rows, so the bar is harder to breach than a class-specific bar.

INSUFFICIENT_GRID: 32 of 32 manifest windows are not covered by this run — crisis: 12/12 missing (snap_wf_20200101, snap_wf_20200629, snap_wf_20210326, snap_wf_20211221 …); recent: 10/10 missing (snap_wf_20200813, snap_wf_20210922, snap_wf_20230130, snap_wf_20230316 …); trend: 10/10 missing (snap_wf_20200331, snap_wf_20200927, snap_wf_20201226, snap_wf_20210624 …). The campaign ruler is a whole-grid instrument; a partial grid is not a pass, and the MDE bars above have been widened to the actual n rather than the published n so that any FAIL reported alongside is one the partial grid can actually support.

standing_distribution_used.config: universe_selective (V227-skew + universe_selective_enabled, V240.A ADOPTED) — identical to the `config` field above. This IS the standing main arm.

provenance.spec: omega/nodes/victoria/training_log/V247_RULER.md (Phase 0, the instrument) and V247_RULER_CANDIDATES.md (Phase 1, candidate β = PRIMARY, adopted). Implemented by omega/eval/grid_ruler.py.
provenance.instrument: paired per-window Δ (candidate − standing baseline), aggregated per regime family and pooled. V247_RULER.md §1: "A verdict is a paired per-window Δ (ON − OFF) aggregated per regime" — and, of the two distributions named there, only the paired Δ is the verdict instrument; the OFF-arm LEVEL spread "can never be the gate".
provenance.bar: one-sided NO-REGRESSION. A family FAILS iff its mean-Δ is more negative than that family's MDE. V247_RULER.md §7 states the thresholds as a symmetric unfalsifiability rule ("claims below $X at n=Y: unfalsifiable, may not be used as an acceptance bar"); §6 names the direction this module gates in — "a floor does not need to DETECT small effects, only to reject large regressions".
provenance.mde_formula: MDE = (z_{1-α/2} + z_{power}) · sd / sqrt(n) = 2.801585 · sd / sqrt(n), two-sided α=0.05 at 80% power (V247_RULER.md §4, and scripts/v247_ruler.py:mde). Normal approximation — slightly optimistic below n≈15, as the doc says. The ruler recomputes it at the grid's ACTUAL n so a short grid gets a correspondingly WIDER bar rather than the published one applied out of range.
